messages:
Maria Chen: quick ask — flight changed, need to drop the tail of my Sat oncall shift. I'm scheduled Sat 2026-05-09 18:00-02:00 UTC. I can cover 18:00-23:00 UTC but need someone to take 23:00-02:00 UTC. I'll shadow 20:30-23:00 and leave a short runbook + checklist. Anyone able to cover 23:00-02:00? @Sam @Raj :pleading_face:

Raj Patel: I can take the 23:00-01:00 block if that helps. Not ideal for the 01:00-02:00 spike but can stretch if nothing else — prefer split over no cover. :+1:

Sam Ortiz: I can take full 23:00-02:00 if Raj is happy to do the handoff at 01:00. I live nearby that night so less disruption. @Maria I can meet for a 5–10m handoff before you leave. :raised_hands:

Maria Chen: awesome, Sam — thanks! I'll be online 20:30-23:00 to walk through the bits. I'll post runbook link and minimal checks before I head out. leaving notes on model warmup / cache. :sparkles:

Maria Chen: RUNBOOK (short):
- check console -> per-route token/latency panel (Console > Oncall > Per-route)
- if any model errors, failover to rdx-small-1 (policy: route-fallback)
- KV cache prewarm: run on host with access to prewarm script:
```bash
ssh oncall@runner-3
cd /opt/redwood/oncall-scripts
./prewarm_kv.sh --model rdx-v2 --keys 2000
```
- quick restart if stuck: `systemctl restart redwood-inference` (do 1 node at a time)
- contact infra (pager: infra-pager) for GPU reboots; tag with `#oncall` in incident channel
- post-check: confirm p95 latency < 350ms on route `/v1/generate`

Lee Wong: small FYI — there's a maintenance window earlier that morning on the EU cluster (03:00-04:00 UTC) so shouldn't affect Sat night PST, but watch the routing policy in case auto-failover pulls EU. Might see a transient bump around 23:30 if traffic shifts.

Nora Iqbal: copying the quiet window note from schedule: `quiet-window: 00:00-06:00 UTC` — but it's advisory not enforced. If you expect heavy traffic, consider keeping the fallback pinned.

Oncall Bot: Reminder: please update the oncall calendar after swaps. Use `/oncall swap --from maria.chen --to sam.ortiz --start 4123458800 --end 4123460400` to record the change.

Sam Ortiz: done — I updated the calendar and put a short note in the swap description. I'll ping again at 22:50 for a quick handoff check. :ok_hand:

Maria Chen: thanks all. I'll drop the runbook link here after I tidy it up. Appreciate the swap. :heart:
